_comment: THE TRAFFIC LAB'S MARKERS (ADR-0441): named points beside streets, where a resident with the agent brain can be told to be (goto <marker>). Read by traffic_lab.json and brain_lab.json (citysim.markers names this file). A marker states a street of the road file by its id, a station (metres along that road's centre line) and a kerb: along = the kerb of the traffic running along the centre line, against = the kerb of the traffic running against it. One (south) is given as a plan point instead, which the road model looks up by position (the interim form). home: a local street with kerb parking on the west side of the grid. work: a local street on the east side, about 760 m away on foot, far enough that the car is worth its five minutes of getting in and out; the drive crosses the boulevards' lights. shop: about 370 m east of home along the same line of streets, a walk or a skateboard ride. far: the north-east corner, outside the ring road. oneway: on the one-way ring road, which has no kerb parking (the car is left on a side street). ramp: a street that meets the ring road by the east freeway ramps. west and south: beyond home, and the south side.
